title: XAI Fragility Index (XFI): code for quantifying the structural fragility of explanation heatmaps in medical imaging
description: Code accompanying the article "Quantifying the structural fragility of explainable artificial intelligence in medical imaging: A novel index for assessing heatmap stability" (submitted to PeerJ Computer Science). Release 2.0.0 contains the pipeline used for the revised article: four ResNet-50 classifiers on the RSNA Pneumonia Detection Challenge data, Grad-CAM and Eigen-CAM explanations under Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur and salt-and-pepper perturbations, the XAI Fragility Index, localization and background-activation measures, baselines, patient-level statistics, unit tests, notebooks and the figures of the article with their data. Model weights and per-patient results are archived in the companion data deposit.
